findings.text: Changing type assertion from obj.(Mock) to obj.(*Mock) breaks the deprecated but supported case of passing a Mock value. When a Mock value (not *Mock pointer) is passed, the assertion fails, obj remains a Mock value, and the subsequent obj.(assertExpectationser) panics because Mock (value type) does not implement assertExpectationser - AssertExpectations has a pointer receiver. Failing input: AssertExpectationsForObjects(t, myMock) where myMock is a Mock value.
